featured_reviews.name: ashok mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy experience...
Thanks doctors....

Yes my friends,
People write many nasty experience they face in hospital or with doctors. Very few write their sweet experiences in hospital or with doctors.

So I thought to share my excellent sweet experience with a small, faraway hospital but with exceptional expertise in the field of knee replacement and other orthopedic and neurological complication.

My wife Operated for knee replacement on 15th...At 11 in the morning (to 2.30 pm) including recovery time inside operation theatre...

Then shifted to ICU.
Operation was good, my wife was in jolly mood and smiling while coming out from OT after the replacement ... But after 2 hrs of shifting to ICU, the real pain started... Wife was crying like mad for pain... But through medication by 8 pm it has started reducing... and she slept.
Nxt day, 16th, morning no pain...and shifted to pvt room cabin. I also staying in the same room with her. Excellent clean cosy room with all necessary requirements like AC, TV, eye catching view from 4th floor Window, attached very clean bath (no balcony), clean and daily fresh linen.

17th.. Sr Doctors and physiotherapist started her to walk and bent the new knee to 90°...

This was regular exercise, bending knee to 90° and walking in the corridor with the help of walker and physiotherapist till 19th...

And on 19th all bandage and all drain-pipes ( 3 in total... For Blood to drain our excess blood at operated knee, one for urine, one at spinal joint to push different medicine ) removed and....
discharged in the afternoon by doctor...
Same day, 19th, came to home by evening.

She is recovering nicely.... Walking inside the flat with the help of walker... pain she feel very very rarely.

After 9th day from operation, today (24th March) was the first check up...and it is absolutely OK.
Infact, my wife walk through out the day in hospital alone with the help of walker.
Today, she has been allowed by doctor to move and do morning/evening walk with walker and asked for further check up after 15 days.
No medicine given except multivitamin for further recovery as she has no pain.

We are very very happy for the excellent smooth operation, expertise of doctors, quick recovery process with effective treatment, support of Jr. Doctors, Physiotherapist, Metron, Sisters, Brothers, room boy and aayas for 24×7 and overall management of the hospital.

Well behaved people....
No extra billing...

We, and no one, before surgery, expected that after operation on 2nd day pain would vanish... she would walk and bend knee to 90°and get discharge on 4th day...!!!

All credit goes to Dr. Rahul Bade and his team including Anesthesists Dr. Ganesh Kolhe at Sparsh Multi-Speciality Hospital.

Thank you...well done, doctor !!!
🙏🙏🙏

Thanks to Lt. Col Dr Amogh Yadav from Mumbai and Dr. Rahul Mane for strongly recomanding us the hospital.

(Note : Treatment was going on at Sanchiti Hospital. But operated at Sparsh Multi Speciality Hospital)

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Wasim Ghori
featured_reviews.review_text:
🫰 A Journey of Care with Globex Health Tourism 🌟

When my 84-year-old mother suffered a sudden fall at home, our family was thrown into one of the most difficult moments we’ve ever faced. In that hour of distress, I turned to Mr. Giriraj Lad and Globex Health Tourism and it proved to be the best decision I could have made.

From the very first call, Globex combined efficiency with compassion. Within hours, we were connected toa leading Orthopedic Surgeon. Investigations were arranged at home and a clear treatment plan was ready without delay. Even the hospital admission and ambulance transfer were handled seamlessly.

What stood out most was not only the medical expertise but the genuine human touch. At Siddhachal Hospitals, every member of the team — doctors, nurses, housekeeping and admin — treated my mother with warmth, dignity and respect. Special thanks to Ms. Darshana Pawar for ensuring her stay was comfortable and to Dr. Mayur, the Physiotherapist who helped her take her first steps within a day of surgery.

Throughout the journey, Mr. Giriraj Lad remained personally involved, checking on my mother’s progress, walking alongside us in every decision. On the day of surgery, he personally visited the hospital, joining me in meeting the treating Orthopaedic Surgeon to discuss the post-surgery care plan.This level of commitment goes far beyond healthcare logistics - it is care in the truest sense.

For anyone seeking a hassle-free medical expertise at affordable costs, delivered with compassion and personal attention, Globex Health Tourism is the partner you can trust. Their approach doesn’t just heal patients - it restores faith, comfort and peace of mind for entire families.

This journey has reinforced for me why Globex Health Tourism is emerging as the preferred choice for patients;

✅ Affordable medical expertise delivered with dignity.
✅ A seamless network of specialists and hospitals.
✅ Above all, a human touch that transforms treatment into healing.

featured_reviews.name: Prem RG
featured_reviews.review_text:

* World-Class Technology: The center uses cutting-edge, world-class Japanese technology.
* Stress-Free Checkup: The tests are stress-free, and you receive an immediate, detailed consultation with a doctor.

* Recommendation: I highly recommend everyone, especially those focused on their careers, to prioritize their health. A diagnosis is crucial, and I urge anyone who loves their family and themselves to get a checkup at Neura Health.

featured_reviews.name: Zubia Ghori
featured_reviews.review_text:
Heartfelt Gratitude to Giriraj Sir & Globex Health Tourism 🙏

On 15th September, my 84-year-old mother-in-law had a sudden fall that left her in unbearable pain. As a family, we were shaken and didn’t know where to start. That’s when we reached out to Giriraj Lad Sir at Globex Health Tourism and it was the best decision we made.

From the very first call, Giriraj Sir stepped in like a guiding hand. He immediately connected us with the right orthopedic specialist, arranged investigations at home and within hours we had a clear plan. The hospital admission was smooth, without the usual chaos and confusion families often face.

Even after surgery, Giriraj Sir didn’t stop at just coordination. He personally visited to check on my mother-in-law, reassured us through every step, and made sure we felt cared for. The discharge process too was hassle-free, handled seamlessly by his team.

The real comfort came when we reached home. Globex organised an expert physiotherapist to visit regularly and help her with recovery. What touched us most was how Giriraj Sir ensured the treating surgeon spoke directly with the physiotherapist, giving clear instructions for week-by-week progress. That level of detail and care gave us immense confidence.

For us, Globex Health Tourism was not just about medical help - it was about feeling supported as a family during one of our hardest times. They turned fear into reassurance, stress into clarity, and recovery into a journey of hope.

✨ If you ever find yourself in need of medical support, I cannot recommend Giriraj Sir and Globex Health Tourism enough. They don’t just treat patients - they take care of families, with compassion, dignity and trust.

With gratitude,
